rules.formatEnforcement: All static and social preview images MUST be delivered in modern WebP format.
rules.ogImageDimensions: Exactly 1200x630 pixels for Open Graph and Twitter Card compliance.
rules.maxOgFileSize: 250 KB to preserve rapid social preview load times.
rules.altTextRequirement: 100% of images must possess descriptive, non-redundant, contextual alt text.
rules.lcpPreloadPolicy: Above-the-fold hero images must be preloaded with priority link tags and un-lazyloaded.
